origin.says: ⺝ (flesh) for the meaning plus 辟 (law) as the sound: the arm.
⺖ (heart) for the meaning plus 合 (join) as the sound: what fits just right, exactly, precisely.

挽.def: to pull, to lead; to pull back, to draw a bow

origin.says: 扌 (hand) for the meaning plus 免 as the sound: to pull, to draw back. It also stands for 輓 (pull a cart, mourn), which had 車 (cart) for the meaning.

挽.name: pull back

ety.hint: Words 言 that must not be broken 折; 折 also provides the pronunciation

origin.says: 折 (break) as the sound plus 言 (speech) for the meaning: an oath, words that must not be broken.

僚.def: companion, colleague; officials; bureaucracy; a pretty face

origin.says: 亻 (person) for the meaning plus 尞 (bonfire) as the sound: fellow officials, colleagues.

僚.name: colleague

渔.def: fisherman; to fish; to pursue; to sieze

ety.hint: To fish 鱼 in a river氵; 鱼 also provides the pronunciation

origin.says: From 漁: 氵 (water) plus 魚 (fish), which also gives the sound: catching fish. 魚 was shortened to 鱼.

渔.name: fishing

origin.says: 犭 (dog, animal) for the meaning plus 夹 (press between) as sound and hint: squeezed in, narrow. Simplified from 狹 with 夾 shortened.
攸 (a person being washed) as the sound plus 心 (heart) for the meaning: a long, far-off feeling; distant, leisurely.

烛.def: candle, taper; to illuminate, to shine

origin.says: Simplified from 燭: 火 (fire) for the meaning plus 蜀 (a caterpillar) as the sound, a torch or candle. The simplified form keeps only 虫 (worm) from 蜀.

烛.name: candle

origin.says: 木 (tree) for the meaning plus 兆 (omen) as the sound: the peach tree and its fruit.
Simplified from 醬: 酉 (wine jar) for the meaning plus 將 (to lead) as the sound, cut to ⺦ + 夕: a fermented sauce or paste.

ety.hint: A metal 钅 hook 勺; 勺 also provides the pronunciation

origin.says: 金 (metal) for the meaning plus 勺 (ladle) as the sound: a metal hook, to fish. Simplified from 釣.

ety.hint: A girl 女 made of beautiful jade 圭

origin.says: 女 (woman) for the meaning plus 圭 (jade tablet) as the sound: first a pretty girl, now a baby or doll.

阐.def: to disclose; to explain; to open

origin.says: 門 (gate) for the meaning plus 單 (single) as the sound: to open up, to lay out clearly, to explain. Simplified as 门 and 单.

阐.name: lay open

origin.says: Simplified from 縫: 糸 (silk thread) for the meaning plus 逢 (meet) as the sound, thread making two edges meet: to sew; also a seam or crack.

ety.hint: Silk 帛 picked off a tree 木

origin.says: A variant of 綿 (silk floss) with 糸 (silk) replaced by 木 (tree) beside 帛 (silk): silk from a plant, cotton.
我 (I) as the sound plus 鳥 (bird) for the meaning: goose. Simplified from 鵝, with 鳥 written 鸟.
氵 (water) for the meaning plus 白 (white) as the sound: a boat staying still in shallow water, to moor.

艾.def: mugwort, Artemisia vulgaris; used in transliterations

origin.says: 艹 (grass) for the meaning plus 乂 (to cut) as the sound: a herb, mugwort; also used for foreign names.

艾.name: mugwort

堵.def: wall; to stop, to prevent, to block

origin.says: 土 (earth) for the meaning plus 者 as the sound: an earthen wall, hence to block, to stop up.

堵.name: block wall

ety.hint: A metal 钅 nail 丁; 丁 also provides the pronunciation

origin.says: 金 (metal) for the meaning plus 丁 (nail) as the sound: a metal nail. Simplified from 釘.
氵 (water) for the meaning plus 虑 (worry) as the sound: to filter water. Simplified from 濾.

渗.def: to seep, to permeate, to infiltrate

origin.says: 氵 (water) for the meaning plus 参 (join) as the sound: water seeping through. Simplified from 滲, with 參 shortened to 参.

渗.name: seep

origin.says: 衤 (clothing) for the meaning plus 谷 (valley) as the sound: having clothes to spare, plenty, well-off.

递.def: to deliver, to hand over; substitute

origin.says: Simplified from 遞: 辶 (walk) for the meaning plus a complex sound part. The simplified form uses 弟 (younger brother) as the sound: to pass along, hand over in turn.

递.name: pass along

origin.says: 疒 (sickness) for the meaning plus 皮 (skin) as the sound: worn out as if ill.

ety.hint: Teeth 人凵; 止 provides the pronunciation

origin.says: A drawing of a mouth full of teeth, with 止 (foot) added on top as the sound. The simplified form reduces the rows of teeth to one 人-like (person) mark in a 凵 (open box).
亻 (person) for the meaning plus 每 (every) as the sound: to treat a person with scorn, to insult.
月 (flesh, body) for the meaning plus 孛 (sprouting) as the sound: the neck. A late vernacular character.
田 (field) for the meaning plus 寿 (long life) as the sound: farmland, and from fields in rows, a class or category. Simplified from 疇.
钅 (metal) for the meaning plus 同 (same) as the sound: copper, bronze. Simplified from 銅 (金 to 钅).
氵 (water) for the meaning plus 容 (contain) as the sound: to dissolve in water.
象 (elephant) for the meaning plus 予 (give) as the sound: first a big elephant, then 'at ease' and, in a common word, 'hesitant'; also the short name of Henan.

ety.hint: A constant 亘 heart 忄; 亘 also provides the pronunciation

origin.says: 心 (heart) for the meaning plus 亙 as the sound, which drew a moon between two lines: the moon returning steadily, a constant heart. The modern right part is written 亘.

ety.hint: To damage 害 one's eyes 目; 害 also provides the pronunciation

origin.says: 目 (eye) for the meaning plus 害 (harm) as the sound and a hint of the meaning: harmed eyes, blind, then reckless.

慕.def: to admire, to desire, to long for

origin.says: 莫 (do not) as the sound plus ⺗ (heart) for the meaning: to long for, to admire.

慕.name: admire

origin.says: 是 (to be) as the sound plus 匕 (spoon) for the meaning: a spoon; also in the word for key.
Simplified from 蝦: 虫 (bug) for the meaning plus 叚 (borrow) as the sound: a shrimp. The sound part was replaced by the simpler 下 (below).
月 (here the meat sign, from 肉 meat) plus 星 (star) as the sound: the rank smell of raw meat or fish.

抄.def: copy, plagiarism; to confiscate, to seize

origin.says: 扌 (hand) for the meaning plus 少 (few) as the sound: to take by hand, so to copy out or to seize.

抄.name: copy out

ety.hint: A contract signed by cutting 刀 notches 丰 in wood 木 (now changed to 大)

origin.says: 㓞 (to carve notches: 丰 marks cut by 刀 knife) as the sound and meaning, plus 大 (person): a person carving a tally, hence a deed or contract.
A modern coinage: 口 (mouth, marking a foreign sound) plus 卑 (lowly) as the sound, made to write the first syllable of English 'beer'.
疒 (sickness) for the meaning plus 艮 (stubborn) as the sound: the mark a wound leaves, a scar or trace.

瞄.def: to take aim at; to look at

origin.says: 目 (eye) for the meaning plus 苗 (sprout) as the sound: fixing the eye on something, to take aim.

瞄.name: take aim

origin.says: 日 (sun) for the meaning plus 卬 (looking up) as the sound: rising like the sun, head held high, proud.

昏.def: dusk, nightfall, twilight, dark; to faint, to lose consciousness

ety.hint: Th sun 日 setting behind a village 氏

origin.says: 日 (sun) under 氏, shortened from 氐 (low): the sun sinking low, dusk; then dark and dazed.

昏.name: twilight

抖.def: to tremble, to shake, to rouse

origin.says: 扌 (hand) for the meaning plus 斗 (dipper) as the sound: to shake, to tremble.

抖.name: tremble

ety.hint: One with a considerable amount 甚 of land 土

origin.says: 土 (earth) for the meaning plus 甚 (very) as the sound: first a heavy mound of earth, then bearing such a weight: to endure, to be able to.

伏.def: to crouch, to crawl, to lie hidden, to conceal

ety.hint: A person 亻 acting like a dog 犬

origin.says: 亻 (person) plus 犬 (dog): a dog crouching beside a person, or a person lying low like a dog, hence to crouch and to hide.

伏.name: crouch

ety.hint: Steam 烝 provides the meaning and sound

origin.says: 艹 (grass, as firewood) for the meaning plus 烝 (steam rising over fire) as the sound and meaning: kindling, then to steam.

抬.def: to carry, to lift, to raise

origin.says: 扌 (hand) for the meaning plus 台 (platform) as the sound: to lift up with the hands, to carry between people.

抬.name: hoist

勉.def: to endeavor, to make an effort; to urge

origin.says: 力 (strength) for the meaning plus 免 as the sound: to make a strong effort, to urge on.

勉.name: make effort

origin.says: 示 (altar, spirits) for the meaning plus 咼 (crooked mouth) as the sound: a disaster sent by the spirits. Simplified as 礻 and 呙.
禾 (grain) for the meaning plus 希 (rare) as the sound, which also adds its sense: grain sown thin, hence sparse and rare.

垂.def: to hang, to dangle; to hand down, to bequeath; almost, near

origin.says: Originally flowers or leaves hanging from a plant above 土 (earth): to hang down, to droop, then to hand down. The parts have fused into one shape.

垂.name: droop

origin.says: ⺖ (heart) for the meaning plus 赖 (rely on) as the sound: a slack heart, lazy. Simplified from 懶 by the short 贝 (shell).

奈.def: but, how; to bear, to stand, to endure

ety.hint: A man 大 with spirit 示

origin.says: A shape variant of 柰 (a crab-apple tree: 木 (tree) with 示 (altar)); the tree part changed into 大 (big). Borrowed for its sound for 'how, but'.

奈.name: but how

origin.says: 舟 (boat) for the meaning plus 廷 (court) as the sound: a small boat or punt.

ety.hint: A mound 阝 of clay 匋; 匋 also provides the pronunciation

origin.says: 阝 (mound) for the meaning plus 匋 (to make pottery: a man 勹 over a jar 缶) as sound and meaning: pottery from clay. The oldest forms show people digging earth; the inner parts became 缶 later.

枚.def: the stalk of a shrub, the trunk of a tree

origin.says: 木 (tree) plus 攵 (hand with a stick): a stick or tree trunk, now a counting word for small objects. One reading takes the right part as 文 (pattern) for the sound instead.

枚.name: small piece

origin.says: 巾 (cloth) for the meaning plus 冒 (cover, once a drawing of a hat) as the sound: a cloth hat.

坠.def: to drop, to fall down, to sink; heavy; weight

origin.says: Simplified from 墜: 隊 (troop) as the sound plus 土 (earth) for the meaning, falling to the ground. The simplified form uses 队, the simplified 隊.

坠.name: drop down

ety.hint: Cracks in oracle bones used in fortune-telling

origin.says: The oracle-bone form shows water between two people turned away from it: fleeing a flood, the first form of 逃 (flee). The traditional reading, cracks in a heated turtle shell, fits its meaning omen; it also means a large number.
次 (next) as the sound plus 瓦 (pottery, tile) for the meaning: fine fired ware, porcelain.

诈.def: to cheat, to defraud; sly, treacherous

origin.says: 讠 (speech) for the meaning plus 乍 (suddenly) as the sound: to deceive with words. Simplified from 詐 by the cursive speech part 讠.

诈.name: cheat

钩.def: hook, barb, sickle; to hook, to link

ety.hint: A metal 钅 hook 勾; 勾 also provides the pronunciation

origin.says: 金 (metal) for the meaning plus 勾 (hook) as the sound: a metal hook. Simplified from 鈎, itself a variant of 鉤 with 勾 for 句.

钩.name: hook

origin.says: 艹 (grass) for the meaning plus 亡 (perish) as the sound: the sharp bristle on grain or grass, then any sharp point or ray.
钅 (metal) for the meaning plus 甫 (just now) as the sound: first a metal door knocker, then to spread out, a bed, a shop. Simplified from 鋪 with the short metal form.
origin.src: Wiktionary; Dong Chinese; own knowledge for the first sense

origin.says: An old character 口 (mouth) with 十 (ten) as the sound, meaning 'in harmony'. Simplification took it over for 葉 (leaf): 艹 (grass) over 枼, an old drawing of leaves on a tree.

郁 was a separate character, 有 (have) as the sound plus 阝 (town), a place name and 'elegant'. Simplification made it stand also for the very complex 鬱 (people hidden in a lush forest): dense growth, gloomy, melancholy.
日 (sun) for the meaning plus 尧 (lofty) as the sound: the sun coming up, dawn; from the light comes 'clear, to know'. Simplified from 曉.

陌.def: strange, unfamiliar; a foot path between rice fields

ety.hint: A large 百 city 阝, representing an unfamiliar place

origin.says: 阝 (mound, earthworks) for the meaning plus 百 (hundred) as the sound: a path between fields; a path away from home led to strangers, hence 'unfamiliar'.

陌.name: field path

origin.says: 扌 (hand) for the meaning plus 京 (capital) as the sound: to seize with the hand, plunder; also to brush past.

ety.hint: Simplified form of 烏; a crow; compare 鸟

origin.says: Traditional 烏 draws a crow, like 鳥 (bird) but without the eye stroke, since a black bird's eye cannot be seen; so crow, black. 乌 is a cursive shortening of 烏.
